{{Quote|Your father wanted you to have this when you were old enough, but your uncle wouldn't allow it. He feared you might follow old Obi-Wan on some damn fool idealistic crusade like your father did.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''Your father's lightsaber. This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or random as a blaster. An elegant weapon, for a more civilized age.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
This blue-bladed '''lightsaber''' was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]'s second lightsaber he constructed and wielded as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Built as a replacement for Anakin's [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|first lightsaber]] he lost on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], it was carried by its creator throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and after Anakin turned against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by [[Showdown on Coruscant|joining]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

In the hands of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the newly anointed [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, the lightsaber was used to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|cut down]] numerous Jedi, including [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] during the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It then was used to [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|slaughter]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leaders]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Upon being confronted by his former master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Vader used the lightsaber to [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] Kenobi, but was defeated. Kenobi took the lightsaber and brought it with him to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he kept it for nearly two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] until he handed it down to Anakin's son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

Luke carried his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] lightsaber during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], before losing the saber during a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel with Vader]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. After the duel, Vader recovered the saber and brought it to Sidious, who placed it in his private storehouse, [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. The lightsaber remained there until the [[Thrawn campaign]], when the [[Clone madness|insane]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]], who had become the [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss]], gave it to a clone of Luke he had created, [[Luuke Skywalker]]. During the [[Assault on Mount Tantiss]], Luke and former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] faced off against C'baoth and Luuke, defeating them and recovering the lightsaber, which Luke subsequently gave to Mara. Possibly this weapon was used by other members of the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]] and/or taken from Ossus by unknown persons after the [[One Sith]] [[Massacre at Ossus|attack]].<ref name=":0">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Specifications==
[[File:Lightsaber-cutaway.jpg|thumb|left|The schematics for Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber]]
Incorporating many of the elements from his [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|first weapon]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was specifically designed to facilitate Skywalker's practice of [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. Per Form V weapon specifications, the lightsaber had a solid casing (either as a whole or in multiple sections for maximum protection against power surge deterioration) and a heavily shrouded [[blade emitter]]. The beveled emitter was designed to designate separate facets of the blade for either offensive or defensive purposes. The lightsaber hilt included a ridged hand grip, as Djem So required its users to maintain a solid grip on the hilt.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> It was also later modified to allow it to operate underwater.<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>

Before being passed to Luke Skywalker, the weapon's hilt had been slightly altered so that the original belt fastener was changed into a ring.

==History==
===Carried by Anakin Skywalker (22&ndash;19 BBY)===
[[File:Anakin_Skywalker_RotS.png|thumb|right|Anakin Skywalker wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber during his career as a Jedi Knight.]]

====Construction====
{{Quote|When I finished constructing my lightsaber, Obi-Wan said to me, 'Anakin, this weapon is your life.' This weapon is my life.|Anakin Skywalker, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
After his first lightsaber was ruined on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="AOTC" /> Anakin Skywalker set about building a new lightsaber. After Anakin had constructed his lightsaber, Obi-Wan told him that his lightsaber was his life, much like he had said about Skywalker's first lightsaber.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

====Dark Reaper crisis====
Early into the war, Anakin wielded his lightsaber during the [[Dark Reaper crisis]]. On Raxus Prime, Anakin pursued Count Dooku and engaged in a brief lightsaber duel with the Sith Lord, but he was [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] by [[Cydon Prax]]. Having been imprisoned on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], Anakin used the force to escape and retrieve his lightsaber.<ref name="Clone Wars game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>

====Rendili====
Anakin carried the weapon during the [[Battle of Rendili]], but it didn't taste first blood until he engaged in a [[Duel in the Coruscant Underlevels|lightsaber duel]]. The weapon was also used by Skywalker in other early battles such as the battle with [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="Chapter 18">{{CW|18}}</ref><ref name="Chapter 19">{{CW|19}}</ref> After the duel, in which Anakin was victorious, the weapon was wielded by Skywalker for the rest of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Anakin used this lightsaber for many battles to come.

====Handed over====
{{Quote|Your weapon, please.|[[TC-70/Legends|TC-70]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="SW:TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
Anakin Skywalker wielded his lightsaber during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], using it in a rematch with Asajj Ventress during the Republic's attempt to rescue the kidnapped Hutt child, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], in order to curry favor with the child's parent, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Escaping Teth alongside his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with Rotta in tow, they made it to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], his home planet, where they were shot down by Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuard]]-piloted starfighters. Once landed, Skywalker sent Ahsoka to take an alternate route to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's palace]] while he would serve as a decoy for Dooku personally overseeing the operation. Confronting Dooku in the Dune Sea, Skywalker wielded the saber against the Count in a rematch, before breaking off from battle when he learned that Ahsoka with the Huttlet had been ambushed by Dooku's guards.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

[[File:AnakinVsDooku_Tatooine.png|thumb|left|250px|Anakin Skywalker wields the lightsaber during his second rematch with Dooku.]]
Stealing Dooku's speeder bike, he raced across the desert to Jabba's palace and was met by Jabba's interpreter at the entrance. Demanding to know Ahsoka's location, Anakin followed the droid into the palace to meet with Jabba, on the condition that Anakin hand over his weapon. Skywalker did so, but when he met with the Hutt crime lord, he learned that Jabba believed Dooku's deception that the Republic had kidnapped his son. In desperation, Anakin reclaimed his lightsaber and held it to Jabba's throat. Before negotiations collapsed completely, Ahsoka Tano arrived with a still-living Rotta. Despite his joy at having his son back, Jabba ordered the Jedi be executed for perceived slights, only for him to be contacted by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who revealed that Dooku had schemed with Jabba's uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], to kidnap Rotta. Jabba spared the Jedi, and made a treaty with the Republic.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

====Stolen====
{{Quote|You won't be needing this anymore, Skywalker.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], commenting on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] lightsaber|<ref name="dooku">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>}}
During the war, the Republic discovered Dooku's location aboard a [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class space freighter]]. Anakin devised a plan to get aboard by getting himself caught, leaving his lightsaber with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] while wielding a replacement, allowing it to be destroyed to make his capture more convincing. Obi-Wan then infiltrated the frigate by entering one of the exterior hatches in a spacesuit. He rescued Anakin and returned the lightsaber, and the two went after Dooku. However, Dooku fled through an escape hatch built into the floor of his meditation chamber, with Anakin in swift pursuit. Dooku made it to the hangar and took off in his ship before Anakin could catch him. Kenobi and Skywalker gave chase.<ref name="dooku" />

However, the ships flown by both parties were damaged, and they crash-landed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. As the Jedi hunted for Dooku, the Count ambushed them in a cave, telekinetically causing a cave-in. With the Jedi trapped, Dooku stole Anakin's lightsaber and returned to his ship. There, he encountered a group of space pirates led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. The pirates agreed to give Dooku passage to the nearest planet, [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. However, en route, Anakin's lightsaber was quietly pick-pocketed from the Count, along with Dooku's [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|own weapon]]. The Count was taken hostage, and the two lightsabers were kept by Ohnaka as trophies.<ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

[[File:Ohnaka_hostage.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker holds Hondo Ohnaka hostage with his lightsaber.]]
Ohnaka ransomed Dooku to the Republic, and Kenobi and Skywalker were sent to confirm whether it was actually Dooku. However, Ohnaka then double-crossed the two and captured them as well, planning to squeeze more money out of the Republic. However, after several attempts, the Jedi and Dooku escaped, reclaiming their respective weapons. Kenobi and Skywalker initially used Ohnaka as a living shield, but when Dooku fled, they let him go, wanting no unnecessary hostilities from the pirates. However, they also warned Ohnaka that Dooku wouldn't be so forgiving.<ref name="TGG" />

====Compassionate mistake====
{{Quote|Young Skywalker&hellip; Not so impressive without your lightsaber, are you, Jedi?|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
[[File:Padme_uses_lightsaber.png|thumb|left|200px|Padmé Amidala returns Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber.]]
After the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], Anakin Skywalker was sent on leave for a "meditative retreat." Instead, he went to the Senate Office Building and tried convincing his wife, Padmé Amidala, to come with him so they could spend time together. Amidala refused, as she was too tied up with her work. As a last-ditch effort to sway her, Anakin entrusted the lightsaber to her. However, they were interrupted by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] calling Padmé for a Senate meeting. Amidala left before she could return the lightsaber.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

A group of bounty hunters, led by the fearsome [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], attacked the Senate Office Building and took the Senators at the meeting hostage. While Bane commenced negotiations with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Anakin attempted to rescue the hostages, but being unarmed, he was brought down. Bound and thrown in with the Senators, he retrieved his lightsaber from Padmé. As Bane and his posse left, Anakin saved all present by cutting a hole in the floor, allowing the Senators to escape just before Bane detonated the explosives surrounding them.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

====Executioner====
{{Quote|Your swords, please. We don't want to make a mess of things in front of the Chancellor.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:DookuScaredtoDeath.png|thumb|right|200px|Anakin Skywalker prepares to use his lightsaber to execute Count Dooku during their final encounter.]]
Anakin Skywalker wielded the weapon during the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] and the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], cutting down numerous battle-droids with the weapon. When Kenobi reminded Skywalker that they were on a rescue mission, and that rescuing the chancellor was more important than blowing up the ship by hand, Skywalker gripped the lightsaber with his mechanical arm so hard that its handgrip creaked in protest.<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)||''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Eventually, he wielded the weapon during his final battle against Count Dooku aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. Giving into his rage, Skywalker viciously used the weapon to beat back Dooku and slice off both the Count's hands. Holding his lightsaber alongside [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|Dooku's weapon]] at the Sith Lord's neck, Anakin executed the Count at Palpatine's behest.<ref name="RotS" />

Soon afterwards, Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were caught in a ray shield trap and were brought before General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The lightsaber briefly became part of Grievous' collection, with the General planning to execute him with it. However, thanks to careful timing with Kenobi and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], they broke free and Skywalker quickly reclaimed the weapon, destroying one of Grievous' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s before cutting down most of the droids on the cruisers bridge.<ref name="RotS" />

====Weapon of Darth Vader====
{{Quote|Killed not by clones, this Padawan. By a lightsaber, he was.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:ChildrenSlaughter.png|thumb|left|250px|Several Jedi younglings were murdered by the lightsaber of Anakin Skywalker, the Jedi Knight who became Darth Vader.]]
Later, following the [[Showdown on Coruscant|duel]] between [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Darth Sidious, Anakin Skywalker used the weapon to remove Windu's right hand, ensuring the Jedi Master's death, and his own fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. After his conversion into the dark side, Anakin continued to carry his Jedi weapon, though [[Tionne Solusar]] later theorized that he continued to wield the blue-bladed weapon to avoid alerting his eventual victims of his recent conversion.<ref name="ReferenceA">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

Darth Vader carried the weapon during the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|march on the Jedi Temple]], brutally cutting down hundreds of Jedi with the saber, with notables including the Temple swordmaster [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] after a brief duel. The weapon again saw use when Vader brought it with him to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and viciously executed the Separatist council. Its last usage in Vader's hands was in the Sith Lord's [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|battle]] with his former Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. Vader wielded the saber aggressively, but was ultimately cut down by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|Kenobi's blade]] due to his own recklessness. While Vader survived, Kenobi took the lightsaber to Tatooine.<ref name="RotS" />

===Carried by Luke Skywalker (0&ndash;3 ABY)===
====Gift of a Jedi====
{{Quote|The power of a lightsaber is to be used ''carefully'', Luke&mdash;especially in the hands of a ''novice''.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="WJW">{{SWComicCite|7.1|War on the Jundland Wastes}}</ref>}}
[[File:His_fathers_lightsaber.png|thumb|right|170px|Luke Skywalker receives his father's lightsaber from Ben Kenobi.]]
The lightsaber remained in Ben Kenobi's possession for the following nineteen years, until he was presented with the opportunity to give the weapon to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. After rescuing Luke from a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] attack, Kenobi presented young Skywalker with his father's lightsaber and explained its previous owner's history (from a certain point of view).<ref name="ANH" />

Skywalker's early training with the weapon consisted of [[Form I/Legends|Form I velocities]] on board the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="SW.com Fightsaber">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20080728.html|text=Fightsaber: Mastering the Art of Lightsaber Combat}}</ref> Luke advanced remarkably fast, effectively deflecting blaster bolts after only a brief session.<ref name="ANH" />

====Battle against Darth Vader====
{{Quote|If we do catch up with Vader, and we must, you're going to need both your skill with the saber and the Force.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SotME" />}}
[[File:Leia_fighting_Vader_on_Mimban_EGF.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Leia Organa briefly used the lightsaber to fight Darth Vader on Mimban.]]
After Ben Kenobi's death at the hands of Darth Vader, Luke Skywalker continued to wield his father's weapon throughout his early Jedi career. Without Kenobi present to train him, Luke improvised and self-taught, resulting in an instinctive though highly skilled practice of Form V lightsaber combat.<ref name="Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat">{{InsiderCite|62|Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat}}</ref> On [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], Luke demonstrated this skill against Vader, though not before [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] took up the weapon and [[Duel on Mimban|stood against]] Vader while Luke was incapacitated. Despite her valiant efforts, Leia only briefly held her own against Vader, being brought down by several light though brutal [[Shiim/Legends|slashes]].<ref name="SotME" />

At that moment, Skywalker freed himself, and he stood against Vader. However, despite his own skill with the weapon, it was nowhere near enough to stand against the lightsaber's former owner, and Luke was relied on the spiritual assistance of Kenobi to take Vader. Skywalker and Kenobi's spirit both completely exhausted themselves against Vader, but not before amputating his right arm. However Vader, himself weary, stumbled into an ancient well before he could capture the Skywalker siblings.<ref name="SotME" />

====Desperation and deprivation====
[[File:Defender_of_the_Cause_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker wields the lightsaber in defense of Echo Base.]]
Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Luke Skywalker used the lightsaber to escape from a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used it shortly thereafter to slice open a dead [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] to keep the young Jedi alive. During the battle itself, Skywalker used the weapon to cut open a hatch on the bottom of an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|walker]] prior to throwing in a [[V-59 concussion grenade/Legends|grenade]] to destroy the enemy vehicle. He then carried and used the weapon during his training under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:LukeVSVaderB.png|thumb|left|Luke Skywalker used the lightsaber to duel Darth Vader on Bespin.]]
Shortly after this, Luke carried the weapon with him to the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in a bid to rescue his friends from Darth Vader. Engaging the Sith Lord in a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|lightsaber duel]], Luke demonstrated his vastly increased skill with the weapon, impressing its former wielder. Ultimately, however, Luke's lightsaber hand was sliced off by Vader and fell, along with the lightsaber it carried, into the depths of Cloud City.<ref name="ESB" />

===The Emperor's trophy (3&ndash;9 ABY)===
{{Quote|You will give me the hand. And the lightsaber. ''Now.''|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Groggin]]|<ref name="Clone B-2332-54">{{WEGCite|story=Clone B-2332-54|book=The Last Command Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
The lightsaber, still clutched by Luke Skywalker's hand, had become lodged in one of Cloud City's lower air shafts and eventually was recovered by a maintenance drone. The drone deposited the hand and the lightsaber in [[Smelting Core D]]. There, it was discovered by [[Groggin]], the Smelting Core's supervisor.<ref name="Clone B-2332-54" />

Groggin had no use for the hand and decided to have it incinerated while he would keep the lightsaber, which he planned to melt down. However, the arrival of Darth Vader in the smelting facility prevented Groggin from taking such action. After a round of aggressive negotiations, Vader left the facility with the hand and the lightsaber in his possession.<ref name="Clone B-2332-54" /> Though he had other plans for the hand and the lightsaber in mind, Palpatine compelled Vader to bring the two items to the [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] storehouse on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. There, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] made Vader turn Skywalker's hand and lightsaber over to him.

====During the Thrawn Campaign====
{{Quote|What's this?''"<br />"''It's my old lightsaber. The one I lost at Cloud City, and nearly got killed with at Wayland. I'd like you to have it.''"<br />"''Me? Why?''"<br />"''Lots of reasons. Because you earned it. Because you're on your way to becoming a Jedi and you'll need it. Mostly, though, because I want you to have it.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[File:Maralukesabercoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker gave Mara Jade the lightsaber on Coruscant.]]
[[9 ABY/Legends|Six years later]], the mad Jedi clone [[Joruus C'baoth]] ordered that a [[Luuke Skywalker|clone of Luke]] be produced from the appendage, and that he be armed with Anakin's old weapon. When Skywalker arrived, leading a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] strike team to destroy the cloning tanks of Wayland, he was forced to fight the clone, which was being controlled by C'baoth. It was ultimately killed by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who then used Anakin's old saber to kill C'baoth. Upon the team's return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Luke presented her with the weapon as a gift.<ref name="TLC" />

===Carried by Mara Jade (9&ndash;40 ABY)===
[[File:Mara-sacrifice.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Mara Jade Skywalker with the weapon shortly before her death]]
Mara Jade owned the weapon until her death at the hands of her fallen nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] in 40 ABY,<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> though she would often use her [[Mara Jade's first lightsaber|purple lightsaber]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Most notably, she used the blue blade on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]],<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> on [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]/[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]/[[Empire of the Hand]]-joint mission to recover the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'',<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]<ref name="Dark Tide I: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> and also during the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Corellian Insurrection]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

====Dream of the saber (c. 40 ABY)====
Around 40 ABY, shortly before he became Darth Caedus, Jacen Solo dreamed of his mother Leia Organa Solo using Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber against him, as he was contemplating on whether or not to sacrifice her and [[Han Solo/Legends|his father]] so he could become a Sith.

{{Talesstart}}
===The lost lightsaber (c. 40 ABY)===
{{Quote|This belonged to my father.''"<br />"''Your father?''"<br />"''I am Jedi Knight Ben Skywalker, son of Luke Skywalker, grandson of Anakin Skywalker. This is my birthright. Lay down your weapons. Or die.|[[Ben Skywalker]], retrieving the lightsaber from a group of Dark Jedi|<ref name="TLL">{{Tales|19|The Lost Lightsaber}}</ref>}}
[[File:BenSkywalker1.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Ben Skywalker with the lightsaber]]
During the time around the Second Corellian Crisis, the lightsaber seemed to have been taken from the possession of Skywalker survivors and ended up in the hands of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="TLL" />

[[Ben Skywalker]] tracked down the lightsaber, still in the possession of the Dark Jedi. The Dark Jedi was preparing to imbue the weapon with the power of the dark side, but Ben took it from him before he was able to do so.<ref name="TLL" />
{{Talesend}}

After the death of his wife, Luke Skywalker retired the weapon, where it remained in the Jedi Temple.<ref name="ReferenceA" />

==='''Blade of Legacy (c. 130 ABY)'''===
[[File:Cade_saber.jpg|thumb|left|Kol Skywalker's lightsaber, which had a similar appearance to Anakin's.]]
While its fate by the time of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] is ultimately unknown, Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber may have been used by other members of the Skywalker family following Mara's death. The antique lightsaber may have been taken from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] after the [[One Sith]] [[Massacre at Ossus|attacked]] in [[130 ABY]].<ref name=":0" />

By this time, one of Anakin's descendants, [[Kol Skywalker]] had built a [[Kol Skywalker's lightsaber|lightsaber]] that had a hilt very similar to Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber: complete with a beveled [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]]. Much like his ancestor's weapon, Kol's lightsaber had a blue blade<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> until it was badly burnt in the battle against the Sith and was lost after Kol's [[Death/Legends|death]] during their invasion of Ossus. Later it was discovered by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]] amongst the ruins, and Rin had replaced the original [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] with a [[lambent]] crystal of her own shaping, thus the blue blade was replaced with a green blade. It would later be given to Kol's son, [[Cade Skywalker]], who would carry it during his battles against the One Sith.<ref name="Legacy 12">[[Legacy (2006) 12|''Legacy'' (2006) 12]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Graflex.jpg|thumb|left|A Graflex flash similar to the one used for the lightsaber in the movies]]
Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] was machined to look like Luke Skywalker's lightsaber from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as they're canonically one and the same.

The original hilt carried by [[Mark Hamill]] in ''A New Hope'' and ''The Empire Strikes Back'' was made from the flash attachment of a Graflex 3 cell flash unit, a flash tube attachment used on forties-era press cameras, with the ridged grip made by gluing portions of hard plastic 'T' track used for the sliding doors of display cabinets (often mistaken for wiper blades) onto the bare cylinder, and the switch plate fashioned from the LED screen of a 1974 calculator. In ''The Empire Strikes Back'', the switch plate was replaced with part of a circuit board.

In the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|digitally remastered version]] of ''A New Hope'', due to a color correction error, Luke's lightsaber appears green rather than blue in some scenes. This is later corrected in the Blu-ray release.

Anakin's lightsaber and Luke's hand were on display as part of the "Science Fiction and Fantasy Hall of Fame Exhibition" at MoPOP Museum of Pop Culture (Formerly EMP Museum) in Seattle, Washington.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.mopop.org/exhibits/current-exhibits/science-fiction-and-fantasy-hall-of-fame-exhibition|title=Science Fiction and Fantasy Hall of Fame Exhibition|archivedate=20170319023052|nolive=1}}</ref> The lightsaber prop traveled to space with shuttle Discovery in October 2007.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.bizjournals.com/houston/stories/2007/08/27/daily30.html|title=Sky's the limit for lightsaber|archivedate=20250114042352}}</ref>
